searchText: I just finished implementing EIP-4399, and I noticed that it refers to `TRANSITION_POS_BLOCK` as being defined in EIP-3675 (proof of stake) which defines it as `TRANSITION_BLOCK`. Should I submit a PR to EIP-4399 to rename that? cc: <@!425572898787426305> <@!291925846556540928>
